name: XCC_UNDO_REDO_LINES_GT
description: Contains the transaction lines being processed by the current run of the budgetary control undo and re-reserve process. For each transaction line, it contains a foreign key to the associated budgetary control transaction, as well as the associated transaction type, action, and ledger. In the case of General Ledger and Subledger Accounting, a -99 is stored instead of a ledger.

columns.name: HEADER_NUM
columns.description: Budgetary control transaction to be processed by the budgetary control undo and re-reserve process.

columns.name: LINE_NUM
columns.description: Budgetary control transaction line to be processed by the budgetary control undo and re-reserve process.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Transaction type of the budgetary control transaction to be processed by the budgetary control undo and re-reserve process.

columns.name: SOURCE_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Source action of the budgetary control transaction to be processed by the budgetary control undo and re-reserve process.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Ledger of the budgetary control transaction to be processed by the budgetary control undo and re-reserve process. This is set to -99 for General Ledger and Subledger Accounting.
